Name: Void's weird Wonders - Cursor (CP)
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Today I bring you something small, yet impactful....the cursor! Always there around you, you have to stare at it the entire time. It's brown, muddy appearance bugging you...well. No more, I say!

I bring you the next thing in my weird Wonders series...the odd cursor! For anyone liking weird stuff, I'd say. Or maybe just some darker cursor.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/3NSVKgHr/title2-1-see-also.png[/img]
